title: The Power of Persuasion: Causal Effects of Household Communication on Women's Employment
Firm Presence, Pollution, and Agglomeration: Evidence from a Randomized Environmental Place-Based Policy
abstract: Firm location decisions impose externalities on other firms due to competitive or agglomerative forces, and on the environment. We study an environmental place-based policy that randomly moved 20,000 firms in New Delhi. Relocation reduces pollution, but firm exit increases. We combine the exogenous assignment of firms to industrial plots with a model to estimate spillovers on neighboring firms, showing that firm survival rates could have been increased by allocating firms to plots accounting for input-output linkages. These results provide causal evidence on how firm presence impacts environmental quality, and how spillovers can be used to minimize costs on regulated firms. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 由于竞争或集聚力量，企业的选址决策会对其他企业以及环境产生外部性。我们研究了一项基于地点的环境政策，该政策随机将新德里的20000家企业迁移。迁移减少了污染，但企业退出率上升。我们将企业随机分配到工业地块的外生安排与一个模型相结合，估计对邻近企业的溢出效应，并表明，若依据投入产出联系将企业分配到地块，企业存活率本可以得到提高。这些结果为企业存在如何影响环境质量提供了因果证据，并说明了如何利用溢出效应来最小化受管制企业的成本。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可以在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Power to the Personnel? The Impacts of Managerial Discretion vs. Worker Democracy in Employee Recognition
Seeing Green: The Effects of Financial Exposure on Climate Beliefs and Political Attitudes
Money (Not) to Burn: Payments for Ecosystem Services to Reduce Crop Residue Burning
abstract: We test whether payments for ecosystem services (PES) can curb the highly polluting practice of crop residue burning in India. Standard PES contracts pay participants after verification that they met a proenvironment condition (clearing fields without burning). We randomize paying a portion of the money up front and unconditionally to address liquidity constraints and farmer distrust, which may undermine the standard contract’s effectiveness. Incorporating partial up-front payment into the contract increases compliance by 10 percentage points, which is corroborated by satellite-based burning measurements. The cost per life saved is $3,600–$5,400. The standard PES contract has no effect on burning. (JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 我们检验生态系统服务付费（PES）能否遏制印度高污染的秸秆焚烧行为。标准的生态系统服务付费合约，是在核实参与者满足了环保条件（即不焚烧即清理田地）之后才支付报酬。我们随机安排部分款项提前、无条件支付，以应对流动性约束和农户的不信任问题，因为这些问题可能会削弱标准合约的效果。将部分提前支付纳入合约，使合规率提高了10个百分点，卫星遥感测得的焚烧数据也证实了这一结果。每挽救一条生命的成本为3600至5400美元。标准的生态系统服务付费合约对焚烧行为没有任何影响。（JEL D86, O13, Q12, Q15, Q18, Q53, Q58）

title: Economies of Density and Congestion in Equipment Rental Markets
abstract: Rental markets are expanding access to mechanization for small-holder farmers in developing countries. However, gains from adoption depend on market structure and the spatial concentration of demand, which implies that understanding how mechanization is allocated during peak demand is key to understanding the returns to policies expanding access. We develop a model of equipment rental markets where demand varies by farm size and location, and supply varies by dispatch rule (first-come-first-served vs. profit-maximizing). An efficient allocation prioritizes large-scale demand, because the cost of moving equipment in space dilutes with scale; as well as small-scale demand in dense locations, because it maximizes machine-capacity utilization. Using novel transaction-level data and a new census of farmers from Karnataka, India, we calibrate the model and evaluate policy-relevant counterfactuals to expand access. Deregulating first-come-first-served rules to allow profit maximization raises aggregate surplus by 10% and reduces output costs from delays by 31% (about 2.8 p.p. in units of average productivity). All farmers experience gains, with large-holders benefiting relatively more. These effects are comparable in magnitude to a 20% increase in equipment supply, but save the cost of that increased capacity.
abstract_zh: 租赁市场正在扩大发展中国家小农获得机械化服务的渠道。然而，采用机械化所带来的收益取决于市场结构和需求的空间集中程度，这意味着要理解需求高峰时期机械如何被分配，是理解扩大获取政策之回报的关键。我们构建了一个设备租赁市场模型，其中需求随农场规模和地点而变化，供给则随派遣规则（先到先得与利润最大化）而变化。有效率的分配会优先满足大规模需求，因为设备在空间上移动的成本随规模而被摊薄；同时也会满足密集地区的小规模需求，因为这能使机器产能得到最大限度的利用。利用新颖的交易层面数据以及印度卡纳塔克邦农民的新普查，我们校准了模型，并评估了扩大获取的相关政策反事实情形。放宽先到先得规则、允许利润最大化，可使总剩余提高10%，并使因延误造成的产出成本降低31%（约合平均生产率单位的2.8个百分点）。所有农民都获得了收益，其中大农场获益相对更多。这些效应的规模，与设备供给增加20%的效果相当，但省去了增加产能的成本。

title: Environmental Permits, Regulatory Burden, and Firm Outcomes
How Rules and Compliance Impact Organizational Outcomes: Evidence from Delegation in Environmental Regulation
venue: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: Formal rules within organizations are pervasive, but may be interpreted and implemented differently by actors within the organization, impacting organizational outcomes. We consider a delegation reform that changed formal rules within the environmental regulator in an Indian state, by giving decision rights to junior officers over certain types of application. Using novel data on firms' environmental permit applications and internal communications within the regulator, we study how the delegation of formal authority affects its actual allocation, the consequences for applicant firms, and the circumstances that lead senior officers to withhold this authority. The change in decision rights led to greater approval rates for applicant firms. However, only two thirds of applications that should have been delegated according to the rules were actually delegated. We show that senior officers chose to retain decision rights over more difficult applications, namely, applications with higher pollution potential. Furthermore, baseline disagreement with more subordinates' recommendations reduces delegation post-reform, and officers facing a higher backlog of applications are more likely to delegate. These results are consistent with a framework where the allocation of decision rights is determined by a knowledge hierarchy and where different senior officers face varying costs of delegation at different times.
abstract_zh: 组织内部的正式规则普遍存在，但组织内的行为主体可能对其有不同的解释和执行方式，从而影响组织结果。我们考察了一项授权改革，该改革改变了印度某邦环境监管机构内部的正式规则，将某些类型申请的决策权下放给初级官员。利用关于企业环境许可申请的新数据以及监管机构内部的沟通记录，我们研究了正式权力的授予如何影响其实际分配、对申请企业的后果，以及导致高级官员保留这一权力的情形。决策权的变化使申请企业的批准率有所提高。然而，依规则本应下放的申请中，实际下放的仅有三分之二。我们表明，高级官员选择保留对较难申请的决策权，即污染潜力较高的申请。此外，改革前与下属建议的基线分歧，会减少改革后的下放；而面临更多积压申请的官员，则更可能进行下放。这些结果与如下框架相一致：决策权的分配由知识层级决定，且不同高级官员在不同时间面临的授权成本各不相同。

Booms, Busts, and Household Enterprise: Evidence from Coffee Farmers in Tanzania
abstract: Smallholder agricultural commodity suppliers in developing countries are often vulnerable to global commodity price fluctuations. Using panel data on farmers from an area of Tanzania where most farmers grow coffee, this study finds that global coffee prices matter for household outcomes, through their effects on farmgate prices, coffee sales and revenues, and household expenditures. The article documents that households cope with coffee price busts by increasing enterprise ownership, an effect that is greater for households without access to other means of coping. Comparisons of mean outcomes of enterprises operated by coper households (which operated an enterprise only in periods of low coffee price) with those of stayer households (which operated an enterprise throughout the sample period) indicate that the former are less likely to be profitable or to hire workers.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的小农农产品供应商往往容易受到全球大宗商品价格波动的影响。利用坦桑尼亚一个大多数农民种植咖啡的地区的农户面板数据，本研究发现，全球咖啡价格通过影响农场门口价格、咖啡销售和收入以及家庭支出，对家庭状况产生影响。文章记录了家庭如何应对咖啡价格暴跌：增加其拥有的经营性企业，而对于无法获得其他应对手段的家庭，这一效应更为明显。将仅在咖啡价格低迷时期经营企业的家庭（“应对型”家庭）的平均结果，与在整个样本期间都经营企业的家庭（“持续型”家庭）进行比较，结果表明，前者的企业更不可能盈利，也更不可能雇用工人。

title: Linguistic Distance and Market Integration in India
The Green Revolution and Infant Mortality in India
The Light and the Heat: Productivity Co-benefits of Energy-saving Technology
abstract: We study the adoption of energy-efficient LED lighting in garment factories around Bangalore, India. Combining daily production line–level data with weather data, we estimate a negative, nonlinear productivity-temperature gradient. We find that LED lighting raises productivity on hot days. Using the firm's costs data, we estimate that the payback period for LED adoption is less than one-third the length after accounting for productivity co-benefits. The average factory in our data gains about $2,880 in power consumption savings and about $7,500 in productivity gains.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了印度班加罗尔周边服装工厂中节能LED照明的采用情况。将每日生产线层面的数据与天气数据相结合，我们估计出一种负向的、非线性的生产率—温度梯度。我们发现，LED照明提高了炎热天气下的生产率。利用企业的成本数据，我们估计，在计入生产率的附带收益后，LED采用的投资回收期不到原来的三分之一。我们数据中的平均工厂，电力消耗节省约2880美元，生产率提高带来的收益约7500美元。

The Impact of Climate Change on Agro-ecological Zones: Evidence from Africa
abstract: This study predicts the impact of climate change on African agriculture. We use a generalized linear model (GLM) framework to estimate the relationship between the proportion of various Agro-Ecological Zones (AEZs) in a district and climate. Using three climate scenarios, we project how climate change will cause AEZs to shift, causing changes in acreage and net revenue per hectare of cropland. Our results predict that Africa will suffer heavy annual welfare losses by 2070–2100, ranging between US$14 billion and US$70 billion, depending on the climate scenario and cropland measure considered.
abstract_zh: 本研究预测了气候变化对非洲农业的影响。我们使用广义线性模型（GLM）框架，估计一个地区内各类农业生态区（AEZ）的比例与气候之间的关系。利用三种气候情景，我们预测气候变化将如何导致农业生态区发生迁移，从而导致耕地面积以及每公顷耕地净收入的变化。我们的结果预测，2070至2100年间非洲将遭受沉重的年度福利损失，根据所采用的气候情景和耕地衡量指标，损失介于140亿美元至700亿美元之间。

title: Adaptation and Climate Change Impacts: A Structural Ricardian Model of Irrigation and Farm Income in Africa
abstract: Although there is now an extensive literature on the economic impacts of climate change on agriculture, no study has yet addressed the endogeneity of irrigation. This paper examines how climate affects the choice to irrigate and the conditional income earned by each farmer. The paper develops a selection model of irrigation choice and conditional income. Using data from farmers across eleven African countries, the paper demonstrates that the choice of irrigation is sensitive to both temperature and precipitation. Rainfed and irrigated farm income also both respond to climate but have different climate sensitivity. Impact models that fail to account for endogenous irrigation are biased.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于气候变化对农业经济影响的文献已相当丰富，但尚无研究探讨灌溉的内生性问题。本文考察了气候如何影响灌溉选择以及每个农民的条件收入。本文构建了一个关于灌溉选择和条件收入的选择模型。利用来自十一个非洲国家农民的数据，本文表明，灌溉选择对气温和降水都很敏感。雨养农业收入与灌溉农业收入也都对气候做出反应，但二者的气候敏感性不同。未能考虑灌溉内生性的影响模型存在偏误。

title: Climate Adaptation
